description: Job-change monitoring for up to 50 company domains: with known_job_ids per domain from an earlier answer, returns only new and closed jobs. The scan is free and returns a quote_id; $0.01 is charged only per company whose jobs changed or that needs a first baseline, at most $0.50. Unchanged companies are free. Use when an agent tracks hiring at a list of accounts daily.

inputSchema.description: Create a quote with domains (1–50) and optional known_job_ids, OR redeem with quote_id and no scan fields. Never mix quote_id with domains or known_job_ids.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

domains.description: Hostnames only, e.g. stripe.com; not keywords or placeholders.

known_job_ids.description: Map of domain to the job_id list from your previous answer. Domains without an entry get a full first baseline.

quote_id.description: quote_id from step 1. Send it alone to pay and receive the results.

name: watch_company_jobs

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

cold.description: hot-buyers: domains below the threshold, free.

status.description: quote: pay with quote_id to get the results. nothing_billable: no charge. ok: paid results.

title: Watch Company Jobs
